entry.subject: 北宋中原 八角褐砖佛塔（原创扩展；建筑细部待考）
entry.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated production city-map building sprite for tianshu, Northern Song central plains Kaifeng/Luoyang around 1093. Reference images supply only realistic ancient materials and detail density; never copy reference camera mistakes or southern lush vegetation. Historical realistic grey clay tile, warm grey plaster over earth and rough bricks, matte weathered timber; restrained subtle ochre and red where structural. NOT toy, plastic, miniature diorama or ink wash. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, ground axes EXACT slopes +0.5/-0.5 (2:1 dimetric), parallel opposite edges, upright columns, NO perspective. South entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. Entire isolated footprint on one extremely thin flat ground-contact parallelogram with left, bottom/front and right corners clearly visible for grid calibration. Only a shallow masonry contact strip, NO thick plinth. Upper-left screen illumination, short contact shadow towards lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background, at least10% clear margins all sides. All roof ends and ground corners visible. No text, writing, signs, symbols, watermark, people, surrounding city, sky, trees outside footprint, modern objects, Qing ornament, imperial yellow roofs, thick bases or checkerboard. Subject: ONE slender central-plains octagonal THIRTEEN-storey Buddhist pagoda drawing motif from Kaifeng Iron Pagoda built1049: brown glazed BRICK masonry, NOT metal, closely spaced projecting brick eaves, small arched niches, subtle brown ceramic sheen without metallic gloss; octagonal shrinking thirteen tiers topped by modest spire. No wooden wraparound balconies; no square southern timber tower. Thirteen storeys must be readable. Square thin ground contact apron7m by7m, slopes exactly+0.5/-0.5, bottom square ground corners readable; tall portrait composition with generous free margins. Original compressed game motif, NOT precise surveyed monument reproduction. South small doorway lower-left; no other buildings or plants. All background alpha zero. Highest priority: exactly THIRTEEN progressively smaller octagonal masonry tiers from base to crown, NOT ten or eleven, leave more vertical room to fit thirteen. Each level brown glazed brick, eaves are ceramic brick cornices NOT wide grey timber tiled pavilions. The reference is only texture/detail reference: this shape must be notably different and slender. Square ground apron front slopes must be exactly +/-0.5, not shallow0.39. Small decorative niches, no huge visible statues. No labels.
entry.negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、场景背景、厚底座、塑料感、清式重彩、黄琉璃宫顶、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件仅材质与写实细节参考；非本图几何或历史准确性背书

entry.created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非服务端披露调用时间

steps: one uniform LANCZOS resize with integer size rounding
pad RGBA; original alpha preserved; no thresholding, repaint, warp or flip

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工量可见薄底面三角点；后角遮挡推算，非测绘；残差不以几何变形修正

anchor_rounding_correction.reason: 按整数resize后的sx/sy转换，避免requested scale的亚像素偏移；未改图像或底面测点

entry.notes: 已逐张view_image原图与最终PNG自查。两候选均未可靠落实十三层；第二版呈约十一层的八角褐色砖塔，保留为通用佛塔原创扩展候选，不能声称开封铁塔复原。方形薄地面两轴略浅，檐部仍偏瓦顶表现，琉璃砖细部待考。单视图；运行时拼接待实测；形制组合为原创扩展，细部待考。
